summary: Report when each pool member joined: GET /api/v1/pools/{id}/members gains members[].joined_at (RFC 3339 UTC), projected from the observed_at of the member's row in the pool master's durable membership record, which Core sets on admission and never rewrites. No Core or peer change.

guide.reason: The API field lands here; the console redesign UI slice renders it in the Members table and updates the guide there.

api.reason: Additive, Controller projection only: PoolMemberView gains required string joined_at, empty when the reported record has no time. It reuses the existing PoolMember.observed_at already carried in Inventory.managed.membership, so no host report, peer body or Core version changes and no compatibility rule is added. Reported whether or not the master is fresh, like peer_origin.

roadmap.reason: Supports the Members table of the console redesign; no phase or gate changes.

state.reason: The join time is the pool master's own durable membership record.
state.record: PoolMember.observed_at in the pool master's membership record (pool peer state), set when the master admits the member or creates the pool, kept byte for byte by master changes and ejects, and replicated with the authority replica. Recovery path for a fresh Controller: the master's next inventory report (Inventory.managed.membership); the Controller stores nothing new.

verification.method: go test ./internal/controller -run TestPoolMembersReportsWhenEachMemberJoined (value reaches the client verbatim, empty for a record without one, kept while the master is stale); go test ./internal/agent -run TestNextPoolMembershipKeepsJoinTimes; python3 -m unittest tests.test_api_contract (PoolMemberView schema parity); python3 scripts/generate_api.py --check.
